resources.string: Allow mod folders, settings and saves outside Android/data.
Allow file access on the next Android screen, then return to OpenMW. This lets OpenMW read mod folders and keep settings and saves in shared storage. Root is not required.
Allowed. Shared mod, settings and save folders can be used.

Use %1$s, or choose another folder. Saves default to its saves subfolder. Existing app saves and settings are copied without deleting originals. Conflicting saves are kept as separate files. Custom save paths are respected. Shared storage access is required.

Choose the folder containing a mod’s meshes, textures or plugin files. The base Data Files folder stays untouched. Enable plugins in the Plugins tab. In Directories, drag folders into order; lower folders override earlier folders. Long-press a folder to remove it from the list.
Folder removed from the launcher. Files on storage were not deleted.
